# Coherent loading audit and a weaker post-loading admission theorem

2026-11-01. Decision: **PASS of the exact coherent overwrite and additive error accounting. Positive restricted admission theorem below; constant-density faulty local loading remains OPEN.** This is a proof audit, not a fault-tolerant loading construction.

## 1. Coherent decoded Pauli and SWAP

For a fixed Pauli decoder R_s, the decoded Pauli is Q_mu=L_mu sum_s f_mu(s)P_s, with f_mu the appropriate commutation sign. Bare logical Paulis commute with all syndrome projectors. Coherent syndrome extraction, reversible sign computation, externally controlled sign phase and externally controlled bare logical therefore implement controlled Q_mu exactly. Because neither the phase nor bare logical changes the syndrome, uncomputation restores EVERY workspace qubit, including on coherent superpositions and on states entangled with the bath. Nothing measures or dephases the syndrome.

Controlled Q_X gives CNOT from input to decoded logical. Controlled Q_Z is symmetric controlled-Z between those qubits; conjugation by Hadamard on the supplied physical qubit gives CNOT from decoded logical to input. The usual three-CNOT circuit therefore swaps the input and decoded logical subsystem and acts as identity on the gauge and bath.

For an initially independent input-reference state xi_IR and an arbitrary equilibrium rho_LGB (including all L-G-B coherences), tracing out the old logical output after SWAP gives exactly xi_LR tensor Tr_L rho_LGB. This is true without equilibrium being logically factorized and without access to B. The independence of the incoming input-reference from the old memory-bath system must be explicit.

These are finite circuit identities. They do not bound reversible decoder complexity, geometric routing, coherent depth, storage exposure during gates, reset resources or error propagation through the circuit.

## 2. Additive initial error

If the actual loaded joint MBR state differs from the target by delta in trace norm, subsequent common storage and decoding contract this difference. Delta is added ONCE to the ideal terminal bound, not multiplied by the storage time. This holds reference-safely. # Protection/access bound: independent algebraic receipt

2026-11-01. **PASS**, with the minor precision notes below. This is an elementary access-versus-protection inequality, not a loading impossibility theorem or novelty claim.

## Hamiltonian statement

For every admitted term H_X on memory plus arbitrary input/controller/bath degrees of freedom, protection of the ENTIRE operator algebra on its memory footprint implies [Q,H_X]P_good=0. Expanding in a memory operator basis proves this even with arbitrary external operator coefficients; no classical-control or product-state assumption is needed. H_X is Hermitian, so the commutator is anti-Hermitian and also vanishes on the other side. Therefore i[H_X,Q]=P_bad i[H_X,Q]P_bad, and its norm is at most 2||H_X||.

Summing actual term norms, rather than norms of an unnecessarily expanded external-coefficient representation, gives

    |d<Q>/dt| <= 2 sum_X ||H_X(t)|| p_bad(t)
               <= 2 n h(t) p_bad(t).

Terms acting solely outside memory commute with Q and contribute zero. The state can be arbitrarily correlated with controllers or reference. Bounded local strength is a bound on actual interaction norms: an external controller with an unbounded operator coefficient is not permitted unless its resulting term norm satisfies that bound. Norms may include the passive Hamiltonian; terms commuting identically with Q may be omitted.

## Dissipator caveat

The additional 2n gamma(t) bound is valid if every Heisenberg dissipator contribution D_J^*(Q) is bad-supported on BOTH sides. Its norm is at most 2||J||^2. The root explicitly demands this full logical correctability, which is sufficient. Merely asserting [Q,J]P_good=0 is not a substitute: the J†QJ and anticommutator terms require the complete condition. The Hamiltonian result alone suffices for the current exact-autonomous storage model and coherent control question.

## Integrated access and collision budget

Use Delta=|<Q>_tau-<Q>_0| and A=integral_0^tau(h+gamma)dt. Integration gives

If a separately established comparison gives p_bad(t)<=sqrt(K(t) r_n) throughout the write, then

    ess_sup_t K(t) >= Delta^2/(4n^2 A^2 r_n).

# Reviewed implementation conventions

1 November 2026. These conventions complete the frozen texts without changing accepted executions or the stated scope. See independent_audit/ACTUAL_RECURSIVE_SAMPLER_BINDING_RECEIPT.md and ABSTRACT_TRACE_POLYMER_RECEIPT.md.

1. Every rejecting local test is a TOTAL deterministic gate: retain a nonzero reject flag and assign remaining outputs deterministically, for example zero correction/coarse outputs. Accepted executions are unchanged. Reject flags are a set of checked outputs, not an unpriced global oracle.
2. A gate is marked IFF at least one input is nonzero. Nonzero top input objects are marked IFF their bit is1. No extraneous gates, optional zero decorations or inconsistent label assignments are accepted. Every nonzero internal wire must have all its consuming gates included. Complete incident-wire stencils are mandatory even on cancellation gates.
3. Internal wires may be recorded inside gate stencils or represented as separate objects marked IFF nonzero, equivalently bounded identity-gate subdivision. Use one convention consistently. Their fixed multiplicity/fanout is charged in S and host degree.
4. Compile the SAME supplied/computable local correction rules and the SAME modified whole-level2 terminal decoder used by the logical frame. Finite-table preprocessing is charged, even if enormous. Do not swap in an unrelated convenient decoder.
5. The constructive circuit/host is supplied with polynomial construction cost. Near-linear established sampling uses preprocessed random-access local incidence and the source's computational model; finite-bit weights and probability generation are separately charged. The conservative polynomial fallback does not require claiming practical near-linear physical preparation.
6. Poisson uniformization is capped at ceil(2Rt+2log(1/epsilon_cap)); its tail is at most epsilon_cap. Approximate each event to total-variation error at most epsilon_prob divided by the cap. Charge truncation, mixing, cap and numerical errors separately.
7. Coherent logical SWAP assumes the incoming input/reference is initially independent of the old memory/bath state. The old memory may have arbitrary logical-gauge-bath correlations. Syndrome computation is uncomputed, not measured.
